metaShifts.description: After 7.36b's devastating intelligence item nerfs created a vulnerability crisis, this patch attempts modest corrections. Arcane Boots mana regen nerf is offset by Meteor Hammer mana cost reduction and Revenant's Brooch optimization. However, the core structural problems remain unaddressed - this is damage control, not a reversal.

Building on 7.36b's strength dominance consolidation, this patch delivers the final blow to their remaining counters. Massive nerfs to traditional strength-killers (Lifestealer scaling gutted, Weaver comprehensive nerfs, Spectre slight buffs can't overcome systemic disadvantages) while leaving strength cores largely untouched creates an unprecedented imbalance.

Systematic dismantling of burst damage sources: Bloodthorn dispel interaction removed, Phylactery/Khanda cost increases, Shadow Fiend soul stacking nerfed, Vengeful Spirit Magic Missile gutted. Combined with 7.36b's intelligence item crisis, this creates a meta where sustained damage and tankiness reign supreme.

Continuing 7.36b's positioning enforcement, this patch removes the last mobility safety nets. Silver Edge break duration increase punishes passive-dependent heroes, while comprehensive nerfs to mobile cores (Storm Spirit vision, Weaver mobility costs) complete the transformation to a positioning-centric meta where mistakes are fatal.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Silver Edge break duration increase from 5s to 6s synergizes perfectly with Sven's burst window. The extended break duration ensures passive-dependent carries remain vulnerable throughout Sven's God's Strength duration, while Sven naturally builds Silver Edge for initiation.

While Radiance burn radius decreased, the systematic nerfs to illusion-based carries (Spectre slight buffs insufficient, Phantom Assassin minor buffs don't address core issues) and burst damage sources create an environment where Radiance carriers face less competition and counter-pressure.

Treant damage buffs (+2 per level) combined with the collapse of burst damage ecosystem creates perfect conditions for Nature's Prophet. His sustained pushing power becomes more valuable when teams can't quickly eliminate his treants or burst him down.

The removal of burst damage sources (Bloodthorn dispel nerf, Phylactery cost increase) combined with intelligence core weakness creates longer team fights where tanky supports with sustained utility excel over glass cannon supports.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Double hit from both ends: intelligence cores already weakened from 7.36b item nerfs now face their core burst items being nerfed (Bloodthorn dispel interaction, Phylactery/Khanda cost increases). Heroes like Storm Spirit and Invoker lose both their sustain and their kill potential.

Weaver exemplifies this crisis: mobility costs increased (Shukuchi mana), damage output nerfed (Geminate Attack), while Silver Edge break duration increase makes his passive-dependent nature more punishable. The positioning meta punishes heroes who rely on both mobility and passives.

Radiance radius nerf hurts illusion farming, while the strength-dominated meta favors heroes who can quickly clear illusions. Spectre's minor Desolate buffs are insufficient when her core items and playstyle are systematically disadvantaged.

Vengeful Spirit's Magic Missile nerfs (damage and stun duration) combined with the overall burst damage ecosystem collapse means supports who relied on quick pick-offs struggle in the new sustained damage meta where fights drag on longer.

Carry.explanation: Only received minor Wrath of God base damage reduction nerf (25→20) while his counters were systematically destroyed. Silver Edge break duration increase synergizes with his burst window, and the collapse of burst damage sources means he faces less counter-pressure during his God's Strength timing.

Base damage +2 and Immaterial evasion increase (15%→20%) provide meaningful early game improvements. More importantly, the systematic nerfs to her traditional counters (burst damage sources, mobile heroes) and the positioning-focused meta favor her right-click oriented playstyle.

Mid.explanation: Treant damage buffs (+2 per level) combined with the sustained damage meta create perfect conditions. The collapse of burst damage sources means his treants survive longer, while intelligence core weakness reduces competition for the mid role from traditional int cores.

Storm Surge damage increase (40/80/120/160→50/90/130/170) provides significant laning improvements. As a strength-based mid who excels in sustained fights, he benefits from both the strength core dominance and the extended team fight meta.

Offlane.explanation: Sand Storm damage buffs (25/45/65/85→25/50/75/100) improve his laning and farming significantly. As a strength-based offlaner who provides sustained AoE damage rather than burst, he fits perfectly into the new meta paradigm.

Kraken Shell rescaling (16/32/54/70→15/35/55/75) provides better scaling into mid-game. The positioning-focused meta favors his teamfight control, while the extended fight duration makes his sustained presence more valuable than burst initiators.

SoftSupport.explanation: Crippling Fear mana efficiency improvements and the removal of burst damage sources create ideal conditions. His sustained ganking style becomes more effective when he doesn't need to fear being instantly deleted by burst combos.

HardSupport.explanation: Lil' Shredder attack damage increase (25%→30%) provides meaningful DPS improvements. As a support who excels in extended fights with sustained damage output, she benefits from the meta shift away from burst-oriented team compositions.

Carry.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs across all aspects: Geminate Attack damage gutted (5/25/40/55/70→0/20/35/50/65), Shukuchi mana cost increased, talent nerfs. Combined with Silver Edge break duration increase punishing his passive-dependent nature, he's completely unviable as a carry.

Despite minor Desolate buffs, she remains fundamentally disadvantaged. Radiance radius nerf hurts her farming, illusion-based playstyle struggles against strength cores, and the positioning meta punishes her late-game scaling approach when games are decided by mid-game teamfights.

Mid.explanation: Soul stacking from non-hero units removed and Shadowraze early game damage nerfed (50/60/70/80→35/50/65/80) devastate his laning and farming. As an intelligence-adjacent core who relies on burst damage, he faces the double crisis of the current meta.

Static Remnant vision radius gutted (500→100) removes his map control utility, while Galvanized charge generation nerfed. Combined with 7.36b's intelligence item crisis and the burst damage ecosystem collapse, he lacks both sustain and kill potential.

Refraction scaling flattened, Psionic Trap slows reduced, and talent nerfs across the board. Her burst-oriented playstyle is fundamentally incompatible with the sustained damage meta, while her positioning requirements are punished by the mobility nerfs.

Offlane.explanation: Movement speed nerf (290→280) and comprehensive Eidolon nerfs (health percentage and damage) destroy his laning presence. As an intelligence-based offlaner who relies on burst teamfight impact, he's caught in the perfect storm of current meta disadvantages.

Wall of Replica damage nerfs (70/85/100%→70/80/90%) and Normal Punch stun reduction hurt his teamfight impact. His utility-based approach struggles when teams favor sustained damage over the illusion-based chaos he provides.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile comprehensively nerfed (stun duration and damage), Wave of Terror armor reduction decreased. Her burst-oriented support style is obsolete in the sustained damage meta, while her fragility is punished by extended team fights.

Track duration (30s→25s) and damage amplification (8/14/20%→6/12/18%) nerfs reduce his utility significantly. The positioning meta makes his roaming style more dangerous, while reduced burst damage makes his amplification less impactful.

HardSupport.explanation: Power Cogs cooldown scaling (15s→21/19/17/15s) and mana burn nerfs destroy his early game impact. His burst-oriented initiation style is incompatible with the sustained damage meta, while the positioning requirements make his aggressive playstyle more punishable.
